case_review.scope: Selected disagreements, not an error-frequency estimate. Exact one-action only; no multistep search.

conclusion.behavioral_independence_caveat: Player may have seen Frozen v2 advice; labels measure imitation, not optimal play.
next_priorities: Повысить проверяемость последствий: аудит отсутствующих текстов/метаданных и видимых SELF-фактов, затем узкая поддержка реально встречавшихся эффектов в существующем Outcome Shadow. Без смены закреплённого каталога, ManaEngine или второго движка правил.

Повысить репрезентативность строгой оценки: выяснить причины отсутствующих LIVE-состояний, сохранять полный join без ослабления; собрать новые игры по недопредставленным классам и экспертные оценки без показанных подсказок. Эту выборку больше не считать untouched holdout.

После отдельного согласования проверить небольшой Policy-эксперимент на новой независимой контрольной выборке. Сейчас не расширять архитектуру и не подгонять веса Strategic Scorer: общего преимущества не доказано, а его крупные отрывы часто зависят от непрочитанных эффектов.

game_outcomes.note: Observed game results are descriptive and are not attributed to a checkpoint.

interpretation.classes: All strict class subsets have fewer than five games. Paladin/Rogue have zero strict decisions; no statement about their model quality is possible.
interpretation.control_v3: Prior favorable result did not replicate: CE +0.16698 versus Frozen; marginal 95% CI excludes zero but simultaneous 99% includes zero.
interpretation.dominant_limit: Quality cannot be ranked objectively with current consequence coverage: 8/204 chosen actions EXACT; 28/1721 menu actions EXACT; BOARD_TEXT_MISSING marks 1482 forecasts.
interpretation.long_games: Longest match supplies 39/204 decisions (19.1%); match-balanced summaries and leave-one-match-out checks are included.
interpretation.policy_v3: Best descriptive Top1, CE and MRR among models, but paired intervals cross zero; removing DEMONHUNTER reverses its CE difference to +0.02468.
interpretation.prepare_v3: Ordinary-menu CE deterioration +0.51822, simultaneous 99% CI [0.18820,0.94278]; no clear Top1 deterioration, so joint prespecified verdict is not REGRESSION.
interpretation.sample: 35 new keyed raw candidates at lock; 33 unambiguous completed Ranked Standard imports; 2 SELF_AMBIGUOUS. This exceeds 25 in newly collected games alone; earlier 13 excluded.
interpretation.uniform: All models beat uniform Top1 but have worse CE; better action agreement does not imply better probability quality or strategy.

protocol.class_rule: At least 5 games per class for descriptive comparisons; fewer marked insufficient. No class-specific model choice. Archetypes remain UNKNOWN without verified deck metadata.
protocol.hypothesis: Fixed existing candidates may improve imitation over Frozen v2 across newly collected classes.
protocol.main_comparison: All seven fixed seed42 models, identical ordinary full ordered legal menus.
protocol.pairing: Unique raw key; same full state/hash/options ID; identical snapshots except seq; shadow seq belongs to group; no conflicting journals; complete ordered menus; block-corroborated player choice.
protocol.prepare_rule: Only Prepare v2/v3 on exactly joined compatible menus; zero examples does not block ordinary comparison.
protocol.review_rule: Up to 20 unique decisions, round-robin over EVAL-1 fixed disagreement categories sorted by score/ID; check every legal action with existing forecaster. CONFIRMED_ERROR only if a strict EXACT living-self lethal exists and model top1 is EXACT nonlethal; heuristic gaps alone are DISAGREEMENT_ONLY. PARTIAL/unsupported coverage is INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE. No multistep lethal claim.
protocol.top3_rule: Menus with at least three actions only; ties use original menu order.

uncertainty.primary_family_correction: Bonferroni simultaneous 99% intervals for five candidates; marginal 95% also reported

protocol.verdict_rule: Fewer than 10 strict ordinary matches: INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Otherwise candidate improvement requires simultaneous CE CI <0 and Top1 CI >0, same signs on match-balanced means, and no sign reversal when leaving one class out. Regression requires simultaneous CE CI >0 and Top1 CI <0. Else NO_CLEAR_WINNER. No automatic live promotion.

qualitative_analysis.limitations: No expert optimum labels, no multistep lethal verification, no win-rate attribution. Lack of confirmed errors is not proof of good recommendations.
themes: Premature END_TURN and overaggressive continuations both occur as unresolved disagreements
Hero Power versus play/attack remains unverified because of missing texts and reactions
Different attack sources often concern order, secret testing or future continuation
Large scorer gaps sometimes depend directly on unread-effect estimates

reproducibility.preliminary_inventory: A pre-inference inventory draft was retained under ignored data/processed_new_matches_eval_2_prelock_draft; no inference used it. Final protocol counts pending/live directories and rejects duplicate menu indices explicitly.

outcome_shadow.interpretation: Forecast coverage and exactness inform mechanical review. Outcome Shadow does not rank strategic value or prove a better move.

strategy_scorer.interpretation: Descriptive comparison only; scorer ranks are heuristic and are not move-quality labels.
